scope: Substantive focused upstream source review, not changelog/testing/version-bump review and not exhaustive third-party audit

phases.initial_pre_execution_gate: Exact AGP and initial Google transitive source-change inventories and focused execution/JNI/signing/archive/R8-wiring differences; new Gradle bootstrap/embedded Kotlin/native loader source inspection; initial KGP/BTA provenance/execution boundaries before bounded local consumption.
phases.incremental_deferred_resolution_gates: Unexpected selected DSL/SAM/assignment and lint32.2.1 inputs and unchanged kxml filter collision were source/provenance reviewed before permitting their newly selected compilation consumers. These were not all known or closed before the first AGP/Gradle run.
phases.after_local_execution_review: Observed actual selected coordinates/variants/class origins and task graphs, closure reconciliation, actual cold/warm payload/signature/native analysis. Observation/review is not a claim of complete pre-plugin-execution enforcement; loaded-plugin records follow evaluation.
phases.candidate_followup_extension: After approved candidate dispatch, exact baseline-to-candidate Gradle tag/tree/HTTP/credentials/compiler/resolution comparison and R8 optimizer-adjacent/configuration comparison; do not retroactively claim these extensions were completed before initial execution.

agp.review: Actual official Maven source JAR differences and changed callsite scan; critical Cxx executable/argument ValueSource changes, JNI producer/merge/task wiring, legacy Kotlin/task creation, lint/bootstrap/settings, D8/R8 invocation and keep-rule paths inspected.
agp.transitives: Official direct/transitive source/binary/POM inventory and selected graph binding. Signing/archive apksig/apkzlib/signflinger source unchanged; zipflinger entry-attribute getter; SDK/download/manifest/resource compiler paths and deferred lint32.2.1 closure examined.
agp.limits: Not every AGP production/generated/native source line; aapt2 provenance/hash and Java/resource-compiler diff are not exhaustive C++ source audit.

gradle.binding: Every downloaded file SHA256 and Git blobSHA1 matches official exact-tag trees; new commit equals executed distribution revision. Initial compare API capped300files was not accepted as full inventory.
gradle.review: Focused wrapper/checksum/install/bootstrap, daemon process launch, native initialization, Kotlin DSL compiler/source resolver, credentials, actual HTTP clients/settings/TLS/redirect/accessor/uploader and capability conflict-retarget paths.
findings: New wrapper bootstrap/auth code is dormant with retained unchanged Flutter wrapper JAR; in-distribution source resolver can call new credential helper, so not all credential code is dormant.

Wrapper credentials require explicit wrapperToken/user/password/system properties or URI userinfo. Current official service wrapper URL declines custom-source-repository inference and fallback attaches no credentials. No automatic owner signing environment access found in reviewed paths.

HTTP abstraction split preserves TLS/redirect checks and max-age revalidation. Total connection pool20->80, per-route20 retained: bounded build resource/concurrency change, no new effective repository host.

Compiler JVM ceiling24->25; explicit metadata-skip becomes nullable while retaining true default, and testing-only compileToDirectory is removed. Effective included KGP2.3.0 and source/JVM17 project graph are separately observed. Conflict selection/retarget changes require selected-artifact/task checks, not inference from a bump.
gradle.limits: Complete change catalog is not complete manual audit. Focused diffs/call paths only; not entire835-line NodeState change, all2584 files, JDK/Apache internals or all native C/C++ implementation. Official provenance does not establish reproducible source-to-binary equivalence.

r8.review: Exact official source archives and actual AGP builder binary version/source identities; R8/D8 commands, config/parser, attributes/annotation-removal/rootset, classfile output, assistant-output guards and actual AGP invocation/keep-rule origins.
r8.comparisons: 21 record-related source paths identical;24 resource-shrinker source files semantically unchanged after package rename except import cleanup.
release_only_deltas: Android DEX wildcard RuntimeInvisibleAnnotations retention false by default; explicit keepattributes controls retained.
AtomicReferenceFieldUpdater optimization enabled for DEX whole-program minApi>=19 with inspected unsupported/catch-handler exclusions/backport preservation.
DEX partition refinement default0->5passes, debug skipped; actual shrink/runtime/duration required.
r8.limits: 39 relevant diffs are not all optimizer internals; synthetic protected-record/annotation smoke and debug APK do not establish application release shrinking/concurrency/provider behavior.

kotlin_lint_native.review: KGP2.2.21->2.3.0 inventory262entries and actual compiler/BTA/session/classloader/reporting execution differences; exact SAM/assignment runtime and compiler subplugins, deferred lint compiler/UAST/IntelliJ/service/loader paths. NativePlatform and fileevents exact official tag loader/JNI startup review; selected native hashes/exports/ABIs/alignment.
kotlin_lint_native.limits: Native resource hash equality is byte evidence, not full C/C++ code audit; filtered filename/hash guard covers only named changed versions and not every repository/group/closure. Actual plugin observation follows evaluation; source review provides initial authorization.

result: No confirmed security/product must-fix in inspected paths. Actual signed application release and exact native acceptance remain separate gates; parent coordinates fresh quota/publication. Build/test success is not a comprehensive security attestation.
